main_measure.name: t-stat of slope of next-24-bar excess return on forecast at block start
main_measure.threshold: Confirm if slope t >= 2 with in-zone falling share > 50%; reject if slope t <= -2; at least 60 in-zone blocks

supporting_check.name: in-zone share of blocks with excess 24-bar return < 0 (binomial vs 50%, two-sided p=0.9589)

decided_by: Slope t is between -2 and 2, so the result is inconclusive.
reading: Blocks start at positions 0, 24, 48, ... of each window. Each window's drift is the mean of its own non-overlapping block returns. The slope t is from OLS with an intercept on all pooled blocks. In-zone means forecast < 0. The supporting check passes on a share above 50%, and the binomial test is two-sided and reported only.
